Profil de ressource: FR Organization Document

URL officielle: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/document-core/StructureDefinition/fr-organization-document Version: 0.1.0
Draft à partir de 2026-07-08 Nom computable: FROrganizationDocument

Ce profil représente la structure pour le compte de laquelle intervient le professionnel.

Utilisations:

  • Utilise ce/t/te Profil: FR Bundle Document
  • Référence ce Profil: FR Actor Extension, FR Composition Document, FR Device Document, DeviceUseStatement - FR Device Use Statement Document... Show 20 more, DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report BIO chapter Document, DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report Document, DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report Imaging Document, Media - FR Media Document, Observation - FR Observation Administration Blood Derivatives Document, Observation - FR Blood Product Transfusion Document, Observation - FR Observation Contra Indications Document, Observation - FR Observation Laboratory Report Results Document, Observation - FR Observation Medical Summary Document, Observation - FR Observation Microorganism Detection Document, Observation - FR Observation Multiresistant Microorganisms Identification Document, Observation - FR Observation Pregnancy Document, Observation - FR Observation Result Document, Observation - FR Observation Survey Document, Observation - FR Observation Transfusion Accidents Document, Observation - FR Observation Vital Signs Document, Observation - FR Observation Vital Signs Panel Document, Observation - FR Observation Work Related Accident Document, FR PractitionerRole Document and Task - FR Task Patient Transport Document

Vous pouvez également vérifier les usages dans le FHIR IG Statistics
